_readme: All lesson content for the 6-week program. Edit the words freely; keep the field names. Put a link in "url" once a video or audio file is ready (leave it null until then). Change "reviewStatus" to "approved" once a psychologist has checked a day.

weeks.summary: How gambling hooks the brain, what you want instead, and starting to track the money you keep.
The times, places, feelings and people that set off the urge, and planning around them.
The thoughts that keep people gambling, and the tricks the industry uses.
Urge surfing, delaying, distracting yourself and reaching out.
New things to do with your time, and rebuilding money and relationships.
Spotting slips early, bouncing back, and your personal plan for what comes next.

days.title: Welcome: why you're here

video.script: G'day, and welcome. Deciding to take a look at your gambling takes guts, and you've already done the hardest part: you've started. Over the next six weeks you'll spend about ten minutes each morning on a short lesson, a quick check-in and one small thing to try that day. There's no falling behind here. If you miss a day, you just pick up where you left off.

audio.title: Why you're here
audio.script:
Find a comfortable spot and take a slow breath in... and out.

Today is about your why. Think about the reason you opened this app. Maybe it's your family, your money, your health, or just wanting to feel in control again.

Picture that reason clearly. Who's there? What does life look like when gambling isn't calling the shots?

Hang on to that picture. On the tough days, it's what you'll come back to. You don't need to have everything worked out. You just need to keep showing up, one morning at a time.

busyAudio.script: Short on time? That's fine. Take one slow breath. Think of the main reason you're here, and say it to yourself. That reason is your anchor for the next six weeks. Now a quick check-in, and you're done for today.

action.prompt: Pick one thing for today, or write your own
options: Tell myself my why out loud once today
Write my why on a note and keep it in my wallet
If I get an urge today, I'll open this app before doing anything else
